tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, popovers sitting on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: search fields, the storage bar track, selected rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (1px).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted front layer of glass tiles and floating bars; always paired with backdrop blur `blur-glass`.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner highlight stroke on glass surfaces.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1, surface-2 and glass (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, paths, captions on surface-0/1/2 (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, decorative glyphs only. 3.6:1 on surface-1: never for body text.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Faint tint behind a selected or hovered category card.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Tint fill for confirmed category chips and info notices.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Light end of the glass gradient; focus halo outer ring.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Primary button fill, links, active nav, the solid end of the glass gradient. Text in it on surface-0/1/2 passes 5:1.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-100 (6.6:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-600 and ember-600 fills.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: Pip's ground and brand moments (cover, onboarding, empty states). A fill, never a text color.

tokens.name: ember-600
tokens.usage: Fill for actions that touch real files on the Mac (Move, Rename): the paid tier. Carries on-accent text.

tokens.name: ember-700
tokens.usage: Text on ember-100; the Pro label.

tokens.name: ember-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind real-file action previews and the Pro label.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text/icon for confirmed and done states, on success-bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind success notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text/icon for held sensitive files and needs-review, on warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the sensitive-file notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only (index failed, folder missing), on danger-bg. Refusing a category is NOT danger.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind error notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Category marker 1 (storage bar, chip dot). Always beside a text label.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Category marker 2.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Category marker 3.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Category marker 4.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Category marker 5.

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Category marker 6 and the Unplaced share of the bar.

tokens.name: pip-body
tokens.usage: Pip's body when drawn in CSS/SVG; same in both themes.

tokens.name: pip-ink
tokens.usage: Pip's eyes; same in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your files stay where they are.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, timestamps, helper text in ink-muted.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers on index summaries; tabular figures.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: File paths and file names shown as data.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, button vertical padding x1.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; button horizontal padding; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a window.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, file-row hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, notices, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass tiles and icon cards (the squircle feel).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards and sheets, like the storage card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented controls, the storage bar, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface-0.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass tiles: the blue-tinted lift under frosted layers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the floating action bar.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for every glass surface.
